calls.title: Ashley Stirrup and Roman Kniahynyckyj - UTS
calls.summary: The team discussed the integration of outbound sales tools, centralizing sequencing in Apollo to improve email verification and usability, while maintaining HubSpot as the source of truth for opportunity management. Apollo will handle outbound sequencing and engagement tracking, while HubSpot will manage task creation, lead tracking, and opportunity management. The integration of Rio for account-level intent signals will guide targeted outreach, enriching data visibility. The team emphasized minimizing tool-switching and enhancing outbound email deliverability through throttling limits. Additionally, Apollo's enriched contact data and Sales Navigator's information were recognized as essential for effective prospecting, with next steps including updating workflows in HubSpot and training sales reps for smooth adoption.
calls.keywords: Outbound Sequences, Lead Assignment, HubSpot Integration, Apollo Platform, Sales Navigator, Domain Health

calls.title: Ashley Stirrup and Roman Kniahynyckyj - UTS
calls.summary: The team discussed enhancing project management by formalizing project tracking through added columns for priority, next steps, and ownership. Roman shared his flexible weekly hours, which vary from 3 to 7, allowing for better resource allocation while prioritizing urgent tasks. A HubSpot audit is planned to assess current usage and identify gaps in sales and marketing workflows. The account assignment workflow was demonstrated and refined to ensure unowned accounts are reassigned properly, with real account testing scheduled. Additionally, adjustments were made to Graham's demo scheduling to limit his hours to evenings, and strategies for managing webinar registrations were outlined to simplify future processes and ensure better branding consistency.
